SEBI to review derivatives settlement pricing mechanism

India's market regulator, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), is planning to review the settlement pricing mechanism for derivatives. This review will focus on the CAS (Consolidated Accounting System) rollout. SEBI intends to issue a consultation paper on the matter within a week. The move aims to further ease liquidity challenges for mutual funds.
